title: Career Roadmap: Research Associate
summary: Support scientific research by conducting experiments, analysing data, reviewing literature, maintaining laboratory records and contributing to research reports or publications under the guidance of principal investigators and research teams.

facts.Current degree: Integrated / Dual-Degree Programmes (BS-MS, B.Tech+M.Tech, B.Sc-M.Sc, BA-MA)
facts.Course: IISER / NISER Integrated BS-MS (Physics / Chemistry / Biology / Maths / Earth Sciences)

about.label: Education Pathway
about.text: Integrated / Dual-Degree Programmes – IISER / NISER Integrated BS-MS

blocks.text: Support scientific research by conducting experiments, analysing data, reviewing literature, maintaining laboratory records and contributing to research reports or publications under the guidance of principal investigators and research teams.

rows.text: Science stream with relevant subjects such as Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Mathematics
Integrated BS-MS at IISERs or NISER, or a relevant B.Sc./BS degree
M.Sc., MS or an equivalent subject-specific qualification, depending on the role
Ph.D. for independent research careers and many advanced academic positions

blocks.label: Specializations
blocks.text: Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics, Earth Sciences, Materials Science and interdisciplinary research.
Admission routes and eligibility vary by institution and year. Check current official admission requirements before applying.

blocks.label: Research Methods
blocks.text: Hypothesis development, experimental design and scientific reasoning.

blocks.label: Technical Skills
blocks.text: Laboratory procedures, instrument handling and subject-specific methods.

blocks.label: Data Analysis
blocks.text: Excel, Python or R, statistics and scientific visualisation.

blocks.label: Academic Skills
blocks.text: Literature reviews, technical writing, citations and research presentations.

blocks.label: Professional Skills
blocks.text: Documentation, teamwork, research ethics and reproducibility.
Build evidence of research ability through:

items.text: A structured literature review on a scientific problem.
A supervised laboratory or computational research project.
Data analysis with reproducible code or documented calculations.
A research poster or conference presentation.
A project report documenting methods, results, limitations and references.

blocks.text: Seek research internships or project placements at:

items.text: IISERs and NISER.
IITs and central universities.
CSIR laboratories.
Department of Atomic Energy research institutions, where eligible.
National research institutes, university laboratories and relevant private R&D teams.

blocks.text: Apply early and review each programme's eligibility, application deadlines and supervisor requirements.

items.text: Research methodology and scientific writing.
Statistics and experimental design.
Python or R for scientific data analysis.
Laboratory safety and good laboratory practices.
Research ethics, data integrity and reproducibility.
Subject-specific tools, instrumentation or simulation software.

blocks.text: Prioritize practical research experience over collecting unrelated certificates.
Senior Researcher / Ph.D. Researcher / Research Lead

Titles and eligibility differ across institutions. In India, some formal Research Associate positions require a Ph.D. or other specified qualifications; a BS-MS graduate may initially qualify for project assistant, project associate or junior research roles.

items.text: Research Assistant
Project Assistant
Project Associate, subject to eligibility
Laboratory Researcher
Scientific Data Analyst
Research Associate, when qualification requirements are met
Scientific Writer or Research Support Specialist
IISERs and NISER
IITs and central universities
CSIR research laboratories
Government scientific research institutions
Biotechnology, pharmaceutical and materials-science R&D companies
Environmental, geological and scientific consulting organisations

rows.text: Select a research domain, review foundational concepts and study recent papers.
Complete a small supervised or computational project and learn relevant analysis tools.
Prepare a research CV, project report and statement of interest; contact eligible labs and apply for internships.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: A strong subject foundation, hands-on research or computational experience, data-analysis ability, scientific writing skills and a documented research portfolio.
